assemblyNotes: Unscaled native solids/shells; global rigid coordinate transform puts screen toward+Z. Debug separation is not operating spacing.
limitations: Native manufacturer CAD revision may differ from current production. No hardware fit or browser WebGL acceptance.
The emissive face is projected above the native cover solely to show the live framebuffer; that rendering offset is not glass thickness.
Uncolored native components use neutral grey; no fabricated silkscreen or hidden battery.

Official photograph states26.25×29.42 mm cover /30 mm board length, while retained native cover26.16×29.22 mm and PCB26.3067×29.2925 mm differ. Native CAD is retained without scaling and the revision discrepancy remains open.
BOOT target is native switch43, matched against the unmodified rear resource photograph. The other native switch58 is RESET and is not treated as a GPIO input.
